headline: Get in the spirit with these horrors from YouTube
summary: Explore a curated selection of creepy and disturbing YouTube videos. Discover surreal art house shorts and cosmic horror picks. Perfect for getting into the spooky season mood.

headline: Keyboards of The Verge
summary: Staff share their favorite keyboards, highlighting them as essential brain-computer interfaces. The Verge team reveals their top picks for productivity and preference. Learn about diverse keyboard choices from expert users.

headline: Binance CEO says 90 percent of stolen assets have been ‘replenished’
summary: Binance CEO announces 90% of $6.3 billion stolen crypto has been recovered. The company plans to cover the remaining 10% of lost customer funds. This follows a record-breaking crypto heist impacting Binance customers.

headline: Happy Pikmin Day Eve
summary: Nintendo announces the first annual Pikmin Day for November 1st. Shigeru Miyamoto revealed new Pikmin 4 details for Switch 2. Updates for Pikmin Bloom and a new 'Hello! Pikmin' short series were also shared.

headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 on Switch 2 Plagued by Severe Input Lag
summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 on Nintendo Switch 2 has crushing input lag. Players face a significant competitive disadvantage in multiplayer. This issue is much worse compared to other gaming platforms.

headline: 'Save Mass Effect' Graffiti Appears Outside EA Building
summary: "Save Mass Effect" graffiti was reported on an EA office building in Madrid. This act follows EA's announcement of shuttering BioWare, the series developer. Fans express distress over the future of the beloved franchise.

headline: Hayden Christensen's Bizarre Burglary Story
summary: Star Wars actor Hayden Christensen recounts his strangest fan encounter. A burglar recognized him mid-robbery at his home. The thief then returned Christensen's stolen belongings.

headline: Anthropic's Claude Opus Blocks AI Game Clones
summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus AI model receives an update to combat game clones. The update aims to stop AI-generated games flooding platforms like Steam. This move addresses concerns over quality and intellectual property in AI-powered game development.

headline: Ukrainians Recount 'Hellish' Escape from Occupied City
summary: Ukrainians share harrowing stories after years in Russia-occupied Oleshky. Evacuated couple describes crossing minefields in search of food. Survivors detail the devastating conditions in the front-line city.

headline: Healey's Minimum Wage Promise for Young Workers at Risk
summary: The Chancellor hints younger workers may not receive the full minimum wage increase. This potential policy shift could occur before the next general election. Critics raise concerns about fairness and economic impact on youth.

headline: King Charles III to Address Slavery in Antigua Speech
summary: King Charles III will speak on slavery during his Commonwealth address in Antigua. This speech marks the final stop of his nine-day Caribbean tour. The King will engage with Commonwealth Heads of Government.

headline: Thousands Protest in Paris Amid Spreading European Demonstrations
summary: Over 320,000 people protested across France against rising living costs. Demonstrations also targeted poor public services, with clashes erupting. Similar protests are observed spreading across other European nations.
